finding.name: full_completion_uses_unstressed_gross_expected_edge
finding.description: v7_graph_forward_guard.mature_session() assigns units * expected_edge to a fully completed session at 1x, 1.5x and 2x. The relation-intent source defines expected_edge as 1 minus the sum of passive bid prices, while snapshot_candidate separately resolves and stores verified maker entry fees. The full-completion path therefore does not recompute executable PnL from payout minus executed entry costs and does not actually apply the requested cost stress to full completions.

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: A history session can be labelled positive at 2x by the incumbent shortcut even though payout minus stressed verified entry costs is negative. This is a structural counterexample, not a claim about the fee schedule of the latest live basket.

required_successor_contract: persist actual per-leg fill prices and verified fee semantics for every completed session
for a guaranteed-payoff structural basket compute full-completion PnL as terminal payout floor minus executed entry cash and fees, not units times quoted expected_edge
apply 1x/1.5x/2x cost stress to the actual cost components rather than relabelling one identical PnL three times
for non-guaranteed relative-value baskets do not substitute quoted expected_edge for realized or markout PnL
combine corrected full-completion economics with candidate-state transportability, empirical both/partial/none states and abort/unwind PnL before routing
